==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am being held against my will in a giant swimming pool. My jailer is a gothic man wearing black robes. The man had memorized many facts about me and he could be described as a frenemy.

He has the ability to transform into a powerful and destructive cat man. This is the main thing that keeps me in line. I can manipulate time, but I don't think that would be enough to keep him at bay.

I am friends with a white haired boy and an old purple haired woman. The boy had lightning powers and the woman is a psychic with a creepy smile. They want to come help me escape, but I warn them that we have no chance of defeating the cat man.
